brief: Chart pack framed around a semiconductor positioning washout. SOX's five-day performance through Thursday's close was the worst since Covid, and GS data show fund allocations to semis pushed back to year lows. BofA's Hartnett flagged SOX trading 17% below its 200-day moving average on Friday, noting that since 1996 readings of 20-25% below have historically marked attractive entry points. The note says SOX has since rallied, calling Hartnett's signal almost to perfection for timing the low. MS Alpha data put SOX on a single-digit two-year forward P/E, and GS charts compare that to consumer staples' forward P/E as a valuation reference. The pack's own framing: SOX is bouncing and reclaiming its trendline, and one day does not make a bull market, but the positioning unwind has been extreme, so a further squeeze would force the underpositioned to chase the move higher.
